patch.value: Item text with an unpaired surrogate reaches the TOON encoder and fails as an unclassified TypeError instead of a typed field refusal

Sentry PM-CLI-3H (first seen 2026-10-15T13:12Z, pm-cli 2026.10.14, environment ci, win32, from an external consumer's oracle test job): TypeError "Cannot encode string value containing an unpaired surrogate U+D83D at index 239" thrown by @toon-format/toon assertNoLoneSurrogate during item serialization. pm accepted text containing a lone surrogate (a JSON \ud83d escape, or a string truncated between the halves of an emoji) and only failed at TOON encode time with an untyped TypeError: exit 1, pm.error_code unclassified_runtime_error, captured as an unexpected fault, so the release telemetry gate treats it as a blocker. Expected: a typed usage refusal before encoding that names the offending field and code-unit index and tells the caller how to repair the text.

A lone surrogate in any persisted item text (metadata scalar, comment, note, learning, file note, body) refuses with exit 2 and code text_unpaired_surrogate naming the field path and code-unit index before any encode; Whole emoji and other astral characters still serialize and round-trip; The refusal is a PmCliError so Sentry no longer records an unclassified runtime fault; Unit coverage asserts the field path for a top-level scalar and a nested collection entry
pm refuses ill-formed Unicode text at the storage boundary with an actionable typed error; Sentry PM-CLI-3H is resolved in the next release.

Duplicate check at create time: pm search for "unpaired surrogate" and "lone surrogate unicode well-formed toon encode" returned no items; grep over src found no surrogate or well-formedness handling. Source: Sentry issue PM-CLI-3H (org unbrained, project pm-cli, id 153837591), latest event 2026-10-15T13:12:45Z, release pm-cli@2026.10.14, environment ci, platform win32, culprit assertNoLoneSurrogate in @toon-format/toon reached from the CLI bundle; the reporting job is an external consumer's oracle test suite, not this repository's CI.

Fix (same day): serializeToonItemDocument now scans the encodable payload (strings at any depth up to 6, with dotted/indexed paths) for a high surrogate without a following low surrogate or a low surrogate without a preceding high one and refuses with PmCliError exit 2, code text_unpaired_surrogate, field path and code-unit index, plus repair guidance. Whole surrogate pairs are untouched. Unit tests cover a truncated emoji in description (index 239 reproduces the Sentry message) and a nested comments[0].text value.

patch.value: serializeToonItemDocument scans the encodable payload for a lone high or low surrogate (strings at any depth up to 6) and refuses with exit 2, code text_unpaired_surrogate, the dotted field path and code-unit index, plus repair guidance; whole surrogate pairs are untouched. Sentry PM-CLI-3H now maps to a PmCliError instead of an unclassified runtime fault.

Unit tests reproduce the Sentry message shape (truncated emoji at index 239 in description) and a nested comments[0].text value; whole emoji still round-trip. Linked tests pass; exact coverage 100/100/100/100.
Ill-formed Unicode text is refused before TOON encoding with a typed field error

value.text: Review follow-up (PR #1479, CodeRabbit): the well-formedness scan now walks the encodable payload to its leaves (no depth cap; the payload is a JSON clone, so finite and acyclic) and also checks object keys, because @toon-format/toon 4.1.x rejects an unpaired surrogate in an object key with the same untyped TypeError. Refusals name nested paths such as payload.list[1].inner and keys as payload.<key> (key). Tests cover a depth-8 extension value, a key, and a nested array entry.
